Import|Warning|analog-coerced-to-real|http://example.org#loop.uA|Analog connector coerced to Real
Schedule|Error|algebraic-loop|http://example.org#loop.a.u1|algebraic loop member 1 of 4; next member: http://example.org#loop.a.y. The connectors form a direct-feedthrough cycle not broken by a state-holding block. CDL §7.16 forbids algebraic loops. Remedy: insert a delay block (CDL.Logical.Pre, CDL.Discrete.UnitDelay) or an integrator into the loop.
